blocker.summary: r471 resolved the .fsi/.fbo cache-format mismatch r470 left open: the .fbo suffix rexglue_shader_translate's docs mention is purely a documentation convention, never enforced by parse_rexglue_cache.py (no filename check exists). main.cpp forces render_target_path_vulkan=fsi as AC6's session default specifically because the fbo path is documented broken on Linux for this title (loses the AC6 EDRAM resolve). The full translation pipeline was verified end to end on r470's already-captured .fsi data: 239/239 shader translations succeeded, and a merged 320-entry registry (49 genuinely new vs the existing 271) was built and round-trip verified. Installing it was NOT committed: it breaks an already-verified test (pinned_deswizzle_slot4_payload_renders_tile_restore) because a previously-single-modification shader digest now has two candidate modifications, and translate_ucode_variant()'s resolution semantics for that case are not yet understood with confidence -- correctness before coverage, so everything was restored to its pre-cycle state. Also documented: a git checkout -- nearly destroyed ~3843 lines of uncommitted test backlog in native_xenos_tests.cpp (which is not at HEAD, same as the rest of the native lane) -- recovered via the build's staging copy with no final data loss, but git checkout -- is now explicitly barred on native-lane files without first checking git log -1. Native ctest 11/11, no regression. Named for r472: understand translate_ucode_variant()/derive_pixel_modification()'s resolution semantics for multiple candidate modifications on one digest before merging the registry; once judged safe, reinstall the merged registry (reproducible from r470's still-on-disk capture data), rebuild native, probe live. Still open, non-blocking: the backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438/r454-r470).
